environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Method validation accepts CONNECT as a valid token, but no source contains the literal CONNECT, no tunnel branch exists, and every proxy branch still emits method plus path upstream or 405s non-GET methods. The arbitrary byte pipe that CONNECT would create is therefore closed for all 12 builds in this corpus; a live status line was not captured and is marked not-proven.
findings.title: CONNECT is accepted as a token method but no build implements tunneling

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
